# Skill format

<!-- Generated by acr docs propose-reference. Do not edit directly. -->
Source digest: `d66801b40427509f586c3f355eb78dfc16472db1314447ea07ed95c0acbb262c`

The Skill Format v1 contract is derived from `acr_runtime/skill_format.py`.

- Maximum package bytes: `1000000`
- Maximum instruction tokens: `4000`
- Required directories: `examples/`, `tests/`, `scripts/`, `assets/`

## Required manifest fields

- `applicability`
- `author`
- `contraindications`
- `created_at`
- `dependencies`
- `description`
- `id`
- `inputs`
- `models`
- `name`
- `origin`
- `outputs`
- `permissions`
- `reliability`
- `status`
- `task_classes`
- `token_estimate`
- `tools`
- `updated_at`
- `verification`
- `version`

Packages also require `SKILL.yaml`, `instructions.md`, and `history.jsonl`; symlinks and escaping paths are rejected.
